Metadata.title: Lumen — See Yourself Through Time
Metadata.description: A private state journal. Resonant reflections from timeless thought and quiet self-understanding without judgment or outside eyes.
Metadata.keywords: journal, self-reflection, private journal, mental clarity, stoicism, peace of mind

Hero.headline: See yourself through time.
Hero.subheadline: Human memory smooths the past and conceals the connections between events and feelings. Lumen is a quiet journal for your inner state, returning your own experience to you without unsolicited advice, judgment, or prying eyes.
Hero.privacyNote: Your entries are visible only to you. Nobody else, not even us, can read them.
Hero.mockupThought: “Everything is slipping through my fingers. Juggling a dozen tasks, anxiety running all day, yet nothing feels finished.”
Hero.mockupQuote: “You have power over your mind — not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.”

Problem.title: Memory rewrites the past under the mood of today
Problem.description: When life feels heavy, it seems it was always this way. When calm returns, the memory of what unbalanced us fades. Conventional tools fail to show the true picture.
Problem.card1Desc: Collects words, but remains a static pile of pages. It cannot reveal recurring patterns or remind you what you navigated months ago.
Problem.card2Desc: Lecture you, offer generic advice, and feign empathy. You don’t need an artificial companion — you need a quiet space for your own reflections.
Problem.card3Desc: Without absolute certainty that your words will never be seen by anyone else, it is impossible to be completely honest even with yourself.

Principles.title: No conclusions made for you. Just an honest picture of your experience.
Principles.description: Lumen does not try to change you or tell you how to live. It simply returns your own reflections ordered through time.
Principles.step1Desc: No required prompts, fields, or questionnaires. Any thought, feeling, or observation exactly when you need to record it.
Principles.step2Desc: Instead of a dead checkmark, you immediately receive a passage that resonates with your state. Not advice, but a grounding reminder: others have walked this path before.
Principles.step3Desc: Day by day, an authentic picture forms: what recurs, what brings calm, and what drains your energy.

DailyAnchor.title: One touch in the evening
DailyAnchor.description: A simple 1–10 rating helps you pause, notice your day, and optionally preserve its defining moment in a few words.
DailyAnchor.placeholder: “A single sentence about what mattered most...”

HowItWorks.title: Experience the Resonance
HowItWorks.description: Select an observation below to see how a quiet quote restores perspective:
HowItWorks.sample1Input: Everything is slipping through my fingers. Juggling a dozen tasks, anxiety running all day, yet nothing feels finished.
HowItWorks.sample1Quote: You have power over your mind — not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
HowItWorks.sample2Input: Paralyzed between two choices. It feels like whatever path I take will be an irreversible mistake.
HowItWorks.sample2Quote: Anxiety is the dizziness of freedom.
HowItWorks.sample3Input: Exhausted trying to meet what everyone expects of me, constantly losing my own bearings.
HowItWorks.sample3Quote: Care about what other people think and you will always be their prisoner.
HowItWorks.entryBoxFoot: Free from scoring, evaluation, or interference.
HowItWorks.quoteBoxFoot: Not instructions on what to do, but quiet perspective.

Privacy.title: Your thoughts belong only to you
Privacy.description: True trust in a journal is only possible when you are certain that your most vulnerable words are protected from the outside world.
Privacy.pillar1Desc: Your entries are protected so that nobody else — not even the creators of Lumen — can read them.
Privacy.pillar2Desc: Your journal is safely backed up across your devices and will never be lost, while remaining completely inaccessible to others.
Privacy.pillar3Desc: No ads, no data harvesting, no surveillance. Your inner life belongs entirely to you.
Privacy.bannerDesc: We designed Lumen so that the sanctity of your private thoughts is guaranteed from day one.

Lenses.title: Canons: Choose your source of clarity
Lenses.description: Choose the wisdom tradition through which your entries resonate. Each canon speaks to different moments of life:
Lenses.lens1Desc: Marcus Aurelius, Seneca, Epictetus. Grounding for focus, emotional resilience, and recognizing what is within your control.
Lenses.lens2Desc: Kierkegaard, Nietzsche, Camus, Frankl. Courage to choose your own path, confront freedom, and find authentic meaning.
Lenses.lens3Desc: Lao Tzu, Zhuangzi, Zen tales. Cultivating detachment, quiet amid bustle, and trust in the flow of life.

Faq.title: Everything you need to know
Faq.q1: Is this a chatbot that will talk to me?
Faq.a1: No. Lumen never holds conversations or gives unsolicited advice. It is a quiet journal that reflects resonant words from historical thinkers in response to your thoughts.
Faq.q2: Can anyone read what I write?
Faq.a2: No. Your entries are protected so that only you have access. Even our team physically cannot view your journal entries.
Faq.q3: What is the purpose of the daily rating?
Faq.a3: It helps you see the trajectory of your state over time: how your well-being shifts across days and weeks and what truly influences it.
Faq.q4: Why is this better than a paper notebook?
Faq.a4: A paper notebook cannot track connections or reply to you. Lumen illuminates recurring patterns across months and offers grounding words right when you write.

Footer.tagline: A quiet space for your thoughts.
Footer.designedFor: Crafted for clarity, silence, and peace.
